title: 第19章 什么肉灵什么第20章 骇死我力
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 王有德脸上冷汗涔涔，仍在天人交战。
而被许二小跟王成安踩住肩膀的王大力，不知道哪里来的力气，竟猛然暴起！
瞬间将两个没防备的半大小子掀翻在地，各自跌了个结结实实的屁股蹲。
王大力红着眼，直冲陆远而来，大声怒吼道：
“把灵肉还来！！”
陆远甚至没正眼瞧他，只是斜斜一瞥，右脚随之踹出。
这一脚，精准地蹬在王大力胸口。
那膀大腰圆的壮汉，身形瞬间如断线的风筝般倒飞出去。
“哗啦”一声撞碎了木窗，重重摔在屋外院里。
王大力倒在地上，发出杀猪般的“哎呦”惨叫，这一下，是再也爬不起来了。
窗户破碎的刹那，盘踞在房梁上的“铁蛋”找到了机会！
它以一个极其诡异的速度在梁上助跑，随后一道金褐色的影子如利箭般射向窗外！
陆远反应更快，手中一张“定风符”已然甩出，精准地贴向那破碎的窗口。
影子一头撞在无形的屏障上，发出一声闷响。
八岁孩童铁蛋的头顶，一道虚幻扭曲的身影被硬生生显现出来……
那是一只体型硕大、毛色油亮的黄皮子，此刻竟学着人样站立，一双猩红的眼珠怨毒地瞪着陆远。
陆远左手掐“缚地诀”，朝着地面虚虚一压。
地面青砖的缝隙里，数道墨线般的黑气陡然窜出，闪电般缠住了铁蛋的双腿。
同时他右手一扬，三枚浸过雄鸡血的“厌胜钱”脱手而出。
铜钱成品字形钉在窗前的空地上，金光一闪，瞬间结成一个简易的困阵。
做完这一切，陆远袖中滑出一面巴掌大的“摄魂鼍鼓”。
鼓框由老鼍龙腹甲制成，也就是二十年以上的鳄鱼皮。
鼓皮更是用的遭过雷击的巨蟒蛇蜕。
陆远只屈指在鼓面轻轻一叩，面无表情地望着那个龇牙咧嘴的小孙子，声音冷得像冰：
“待着，还没到你！”
一声闷响仿佛直接敲在魂魄上。
小孙子浑身剧烈一僵，猩红的眼珠里闪过极度的不甘与恐惧。
最终还是不情愿地伏低了身子，不敢再动弹分毫。
料理完这边，陆远这才重新将目光投向从始至终没有动作的王有德。
也就在这时，房门被人“砰”的一声，从外面一脚踹开。
七八个村民手持锄头、铁耙，气势汹汹地冲了进来。
陆远本以为他们是来帮忙驱邪的。
结果，为首的一个四十多岁的老汉，压根没看那中邪的小孙子，而是冲着王有德急吼吼地喊道：
“不能给灵肉！！”
“村长！咱都联系好城里商会了！人家明天就上门来收，一万三千块啊！！”
他身后的人群瞬间炸开了锅，一个个情绪激动，面目狰狞。
“就是！王有德！这黄皮子当初是我们豁出命帮你一起打死的！”
“说好卖了灵肉，一人给我们二百块好处费！你可不能赖账！”
“你没了灵肉，拿什么给我们钱！”
“再说了，你家有了一万多块，你儿子大力能娶多少房老婆，能给你生多少个大胖孙子！”
“赶紧把灵肉拿回来！不然别怪我们翻脸不认人！！”
村民们死死盯着陆远手中的粉色灵肉，眼睛彻底红了。
content_en:
Wang Youde's face was dripping with cold sweat, and he was still fighting between heaven and man.
And Wang Dali, who had his shoulders stepped on by Xu Erxiao and Wang Chengan, suddenly got the strength from someone who didn't know where he came from!
In an instant, the two unsuspecting young men were thrown to the ground, and each fell into a squat squat.
Wang Dali's eyes turned red as he rushed towards Lu Yuan and roared loudly:
"Give me back your soul and body!!"
Lu Yuan didn't even look at him, he just glanced sideways and kicked out his right foot.
This kick hit Wang Dali's chest accurately.
The strong man with big arms and round waist instantly flew backwards like a kite with its string broken.
The wooden window was smashed with a "crash" sound, and it fell heavily into the courtyard outside the house.
Wang Dali fell to the ground and screamed "Ouch" like a slaughtering pig. This time, he could not get up again.
The moment the window shattered, the "iron egg" entrenched on the beam found an opportunity!
It ran on the beam at an extremely weird speed, and then a golden-brown shadow shot out of the window like a sharp arrow!
Lu Yuan reacted faster, and had already thrown out a "Fixing Wind Talisman" in his hand, accurately sticking it towards the broken window.
The shadow hit the invisible barrier and made a muffled sound.
Above the head of the eight-year-old child Tiedan, an illusory and twisted figure was forcibly revealed...
It was a large yellow-skinned creature with shiny fur. At this moment, it was standing up like a human, with a pair of scarlet eyes glaring at Lu Yuan resentfully.
Lu Yuan pinched the "Earth Binding Technique" with his left hand and pressed it toward the ground.
From the cracks in the blue bricks on the ground, several streaks of black air like ink lines suddenly shot out, wrapping around Tiedan's legs like lightning.
At the same time, he raised his right hand, and three "win-weary coins" dipped in rooster blood came out.
The finished copper coins were nailed to the open space in front of the window. The golden light flashed and a simple trap formation was instantly formed.
After doing all this, a palm-sized "soul-taking drum" slipped out of Lu Yuan's sleeve.
The drum frame is made of old falcon plastron, which is crocodile skin that is more than twenty years old.
The drum skin is even made from the slough of a giant python that has been struck by lightning.
Lu Yuan only tapped his finger on the drum head lightly, looking at the grinning grandson expressionlessly, and his voice was as cold as ice:
"Wait, it's not your turn yet!"
A muffled sound seemed to hit the soul directly.
The little grandson's whole body stiffened violently, and extreme reluctance and fear flashed in his scarlet eyes.
In the end, he reluctantly lowered his body, not daring to move at all.
After finishing the meal, Lu Yuan turned his attention again to Wang Youde, who had been motionless from beginning to end.
At this moment, the door was kicked open from the outside with a "bang" sound.
Seven or eight villagers armed with hoes and rakes rushed in menacingly.
Lu Yuan thought they were here to help exorcise evil spirits.
As a result, the leader, an old man in his forties, did not look at the possessed grandson at all, but shouted urgently at Wang Youde:
"Can't give spiritual flesh!!"
"Village Chief! We have already contacted the city's chamber of commerce! They will come to collect it tomorrow. It's 13,000 yuan!!"
The crowd behind him exploded instantly, everyone was excited and looked ferocious.
"That's right! Wang Youde! We risked our lives to help you beat this yellow man to death!"
"We agreed that if we sell our spiritual flesh, we'll each receive two hundred yuan as a commission! You can't default on your debt!"
"How can you give us money if you don't have your soul and body!"
"Besides, your family has more than 10,000 yuan. How many wives can your son Dali marry and how many fat grandchildren can he give you?"
"Hurry up and get your soul and body back! Otherwise, don't blame us for turning against you!!"
The villagers stared at the pink spiritual flesh in Lu Yuan's hand, their eyes turning completely red.
